title: Banana Islands: Snorkel & History
summary: A short, unhurried crossing to three off-grid islands — reef snorkeling, old gun emplacements, and no cars, no roads, and no schedule but your own.
highlights: Snorkeling the reef off Dublin island
A walk to the old British gun emplacements
An afternoon fishing with a local boat crew
A slow sunset crossing back to the peninsula

itinerary.title: Cross to the islands
itinerary.description: Road transfer to Kent, a short boat crossing, and an afternoon snorkeling the reef off Dublin.

itinerary.title: History & fishing, then home
itinerary.description: A morning walk to the old gun emplacements and a fishing trip with a local crew, then a sunset crossing back.

included: The boat crossing and reef snorkeling gear
Road transfer to and from Kent
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
